update: etcd raft adjacent update (update.patch): old/source (V02 model revision 3d0faba4) -> new/source
overall_reason: Most of the suite stays as it is, including every core safety, durability, read and V02-update property. The update changes three requirements that existing properties encode: (1) leader conf-change admission (new joint-state refusals), (2) uncommitted-size quota (payloads of size zero are never refused), and (3) auto-leave (a nil-Data leave is never refused, pendingConfIndex is bumped, and a crossing guard prevents duplicates). It also adds two obligations that no current property checks: aborting a lead transfer when the transferee is demoted, and probing new replicas right away when a conf change is applied. ProposalConfigurationDecisions, OutcomeSoundness and AutoLeaveAdvance (with its alias UpdateAutoLeaveAdvance) must be modified. Correct new code violates the first two. The old AutoLeaveAdvance does not forbid duplicate leave entries, which crashed the old source. It also keeps an escape for a quota refusal that is now obsolete. Four properties are added: PendingConfCoversUnapplied, AppliedConfJointDiscipline, LeaderTransferTargetVoter and NewReplicaProbedOnConfApply (a progress contract), plus reachability canaries. Nothing is removed. Several proposed properties are predicted to be violated by the new source (D1, D2, D3 below). These are reported as defects and are not grounds for weakening the properties.

semantic_requirement_changes: Conf-change admission: while joint, refuse every conf change with non-empty Changes; while not joint, refuse an empty-Changes conf change (raft.go:1052-1071).
Quota: a proposal whose total payload size is 0 is never refused (raft.go:1616; raft_test.go:189,251-258).

Auto-leave: appended only when applied crosses pendingConfIndex; Data=nil (size 0) and refusal panics; pendingConfIndex := index of the leave (raft.go:563-583; rawnode_test.go:317-328; testdata/confchange_v2_add_double_auto.txt:238-279 duplicate-leave regression).
Lead transfer is aborted when the transferee is no longer a voter in either half (demotion as well as removal) (raft.go:1568-1571; raft_test.go:3617).

When a conf change applied at the leader does not advance commit, the leader still probes every replica with maybeSendAppend(id,false) (raft.go:1556-1567; testdata/confchange_v2_add_double_auto.txt:53-62).
representation_or_observer_migrations: New Progress.Next = LastIndex instead of LastIndex+1 (confchange.go:265). Snapshot restore therefore gives self Match=s.index-1, Next=s.index (raft.go:1469-1483).
The auto-leave entry has payload weight 0 and the encoded size of a nil-Data entry (same size as the leader's empty entry). Previously it was 2 payload bytes and a 10-byte entry (base.tla:78-83).
advance() reduces the quota before it appends the auto-leave entry (raft.go:557).
Observer fields needed: ProposalObservation.joint/.cfgIndex, autoLeaveChecks crossing fields, EffectObservation leader/transfer/probe fields.
pre_existing_property_defect_repairs: ProposalContract and OutcomeSoundness copied the implementation's pendingConf variable. They could not detect a conf change admitted while a raft-generated leave entry was still unapplied (the old source did this).
AutoLeaveAdvance only checked the eligible => append direction. It allowed duplicate leaves and a stale 'DropQuota' decision field as an escape.
No property checked that an applied conf entry matches the joint state (an apply-time panic). Only NoUnexpectedFatal, which is disabled in most configs, would notice.
change_classification.unchanged_requirements: Election/log/commit/apply safety, durability/promise backing, read safety, V02 learner-vote/ready/joint-restore contracts, vote/campaign/transfer decision contracts, quota integrity, config origin/shape.

entries.name: ProposalConfigurationDecisions (ProposalContract)
evidence: new raft.go:1052-1071: alreadyPending / alreadyJoint&&!wantsLeaveJoint / !alreadyJoint&&wantsLeaveJoint rewrite to EntryNormal; wantsLeaveJoint = len(cc.AsV2().Changes)==0
new raft.go:1616 vs old raft.go:1573: added s>0 to the quota refusal
tests: testdata/confchange_v2_add_single_explicit.txt:100-106 (joint refusal), :165-168 (non-joint empty refusal); raft_test.go:251-258 (empty proposal accepted over limit)
entries.old_expression: rewritten == {k: conf(k) /\ (o.pending>o.applied \/ \E j<k: conf(j))}; DropQuota iff o.quota>0 /\ o.quota+weight>MaxUncommitted
entries.proposed_expression:
ProposalContract(o) ==
  LET IsConf(e) == e.kind \in ConfKinds
      JointOK(e) == IF o.joint THEN e.changes = <<>> ELSE e.changes # <<>>
      admitted == IF o.pending > o.applied THEN {} ELSE
          {k \in DOMAIN o.entries: IsConf(o.entries[k]) /\ JointOK(o.entries[k]) /\
             \A j \in 1..(k-1): ~(IsConf(o.entries[j]) /\ JointOK(o.entries[j]))}
      rewritten == {k \in DOMAIN o.entries: IsConf(o.entries[k])} \ admitted
      effective == [k \in DOMAIN o.entries |-> IF k \in rewritten THEN Entry(0,0,"Normal",0,0,0,EmptyEncoded) ELSE o.entries[k]]
      weight == Weight(effective)
      expected == IF o.role="Leader" THEN
            IF o.node \notin o.voters \cup o.learners THEN "DropRemoved"
            ELSE IF o.transfer#0 THEN "DropTransfer"
            ELSE IF o.quota>0 /\ weight>0 /\ o.quota+weight>MaxUncommitted THEN "DropQuota" ELSE "Accepted"
          ELSE IF o.role#"Follower" \/ o.lead=0 THEN "DropNoLeader"
          ELSE IF o.noForward THEN "DropForwardDisabled" ELSE "Forwarded"
  IN /\ o.decision = expected
     /\ (expected="Accepted" => <old content conjuncts of base.tla:756-764 with this 'effective'>)
     /\ (expected#"Accepted" => o.after = o.before)
     /\ ((expected="Accepted" /\ admitted#{}) =>
            \A i \in (o.cfgIndex+1)..Len(o.before): o.before[i].kind \notin ConfKinds)

Observer migration: ProposalObservation adds joint |-> r.config.outgoing#{} and cfgIndex |-> Len(r.cfgHist).
disagreement_witness: W-P1 (joint refusal; V2 workload, e.g. Update_full): leader s1 has applied V2 JointExplicit <<Update s1>>, so config=(s1 s2 s3)&&(s1 s2 s3), autoLeave=FALSE, pendingConf<=applied. Propose V2 Auto <<AddVoter s2>> (w=1). New source and model rewrite it to EntryNormal: the old contract expects the V2 entry and fails, the proposed contract holds. On the old model the entry is admitted and the proposed contract fails.

W-P2 (non-joint leave refusal): non-joint leader with no pending conf. Propose V2 Auto <<>>. The old contract expects it admitted; the new source rewrites it (the old model admits it and Fatals at apply).

W-P3 (quota s>0; MC_hunt_6_outcomes: PayloadWeights {0,1,3}, MaxUncommitted 2): leader s1 with quota 0 accepts Normal w=3, so quota=3. Then Normal w=0: the old contract expects DropQuota, the new source accepts.

W-P4 (requirement-level conjunct, old model): joint autoLeave leader appended a leave L, but the old code left pendingConf at J<=applied. A subsequent conf proposal is admitted while L is unapplied: the old contract holds and the proposed conjunct is violated.

predicted.old_model: violates proposed (W-P1, W-P2, W-P4); old contract holds
predicted.new_model_after_migration: proposed holds with EarlyAdvance=FALSE. With EarlyAdvance=TRUE the cfgIndex conjunct can fail (D2c). The old contract fails on W-P1..W-P3

entries.notes: Decision equality keeps the source's exact len(Changes)==0 rule. Under that rule a {JointExplicit|JointImplicit, Changes=[]} change made while joint is 'Accepted'. That case is reported by AppliedConfJointDiscipline (D3) instead, and its classification is unresolved (U3).

entries.name: OutcomeSoundness (ExpectedDecision)
evidence: old property base.tla:1393-1399; outcome weight built at base.tla:906-910 from the model's RewriteConf
entries.proposed_expression:
ExpectedDecision(o) == IF o.role="Leader" THEN
   IF ~o.member THEN "DropRemoved" ELSE IF o.transfer#0 THEN "DropTransfer"
   ELSE IF o.quota>0 /\ o.weight>0 /\ o.quota+o.weight>MaxUncommitted THEN "DropQuota" ELSE "Accepted"
 ELSE <unchanged>
Representation: outcome.weight must be Weight(effective) of the joint-aware rewrite (same definition as ProposalContract), computed independently of the model's RewriteConf so that the property does not copy the implementation.
disagreement_witness: W-P3: the old property expects DropQuota and the new source returns Accepted, with the proposal appended.

predicted.old_model: proposed violated on W-P3 (old model refuses)
predicted.new_model_after_migration: proposed holds; the old property fails on W-P3

entries.name: AutoLeaveAdvance (and Update.tla alias UpdateAutoLeaveAdvance)
evidence: new raft.go:556-593: reduce quota first; guard AutoLeave && oldApplied < pendingConfIndex && newApplied >= pendingConfIndex && leader; Data=nil; refusal panics; pendingConfIndex = lastIndex
old raft.go:556-583: guard index >= pendingConfIndex; pendingConfIndex bumped only on refusal, so later advances re-append
testdata/confchange_v2_add_double_auto.txt:238-279: regression for the old duplicate-leave panic
old property base.tla:1357-1362; observer base.tla:1129-1132; model base.tla:1101-1115
entries.old_expression: a.eligible (autoLeave /\ cursor>=pendingConf /\ leader) => (one V2 leave appended) \/ (a.decision="DropQuota" /\ a.pending=Len(a.afterHist))
entries.proposed_expression:
AutoLeaveAdvance == \A a \in history.autoLeaveChecks:
  LET n == Len(a.afterHist)
      appended == /\ n = a.beforeLast+1 /\ Prefix(a.afterHist,a.beforeLast) = a.beforeHist
                  /\ IsLeave(a.afterHist[n]) /\ a.afterHist[n].id = 0 /\ a.afterHist[n].term = a.term
      eligible == /\ a.leader /\ a.member /\ a.autoLeave /\ a.cursor > 0
                  /\ a.newApplied >= a.pendingBefore
                  /\ a.unappliedConf = {}
  IN /\ appended <=> eligible
     /\ appended => (a.pending = n /\ a.fatal = "")
     /\ ~appended => a.afterHist = a.beforeHist

Observer (ProtocolAdvance): [leader |-> r.role="Leader", member |-> r.id \in Members(r), autoLeave |-> r.config.autoLeave, term |-> r.term, cursor |-> b.cursor, oldApplied |-> r.applied, newApplied |-> a.applied, pendingBefore |-> r.pendingConf, pending |-> a.pendingConf, unappliedConf |-> {k \in (Len(r.cfgHist)+1)..Last(r): Hist(r)[k].kind \in ConfKinds}, beforeLast |-> Last(r), beforeHist |-> Hist(r), afterHist |-> Hist(a), fatal |-> a.fatal]. The stale 'decision' field is dropped: AdvanceCore never resets it.
disagreement_witness: W-AL1 (old duplicate; Update_hunt_autoleave, EarlyAdvance=FALSE): s1 leader admits J=V2 JointImplicit <<Update s1>> at i, then a second V2 proposal that is rewritten to Normal at i+1. Ready#1 commits only [J]; apply J; Advance appends leave L1 at i+2. Ready#2 commits [i+1]; Advance (cursor i+1 >= pendingConf i, autoLeave still TRUE) makes the old source/model append L2 at i+3. The old property holds. The proposed property fails because unappliedConf={i+2}. The new source does not append (oldApplied i, pendingConf i+2 > cursor).
W-AL0 (old normal path): the first auto-leave on the old model leaves pendingConf=J != n. The proposed conjunct 'appended => pending=n' fails and the old property holds.

W-AL2 (new D1; Update_hunt_autoleave, EarlyAdvance=FALSE, PreVote/CheckQuorum off): J committed and applied on s1, s2, s3 (raft.applied=J everywhere). s1's leave is not delivered. s2 campaigns at term 2 (s3 votes) and becomes leader with pendingConf=J=applied, then appends its empty entry J+1. J+1 commits, is applied, and Advance runs with cursor J+1. New source: oldApplied J < pendingConf J is false, so no leave is ever appended. Both the old and the proposed property fail; the old source appends.

W-AL3 (new D2b; EarlyAdvance=TRUE, e.g. Update_full): the leader has leave L (pendingConf=L). The Ready committing L is queued and Advance runs before ApplyEntry(L), so the config is still autoLeave. New source appends a second leave L'. The old property holds (eligible under old definition) and the proposed property fails (unappliedConf={L}). Later ApplyEntry(L') Fatals.

W-AL4 (new D2a; EarlyAdvance=TRUE): Advance crossing J runs before ApplyEntry(J), so no append. After ApplyEntry(J), the next Advance with cursor>0 is eligible. The new source never appends: both properties fail.

predicted.new_model_after_migration: proposed violated by D1 (W-AL2) even with EarlyAdvance=FALSE, and by D2a/D2b with EarlyAdvance=TRUE. Holds on the normal crossing path.
predicted.new_source: same as the new model; D1 is a source-level defect

entries.notes: The 'must append' direction is a per-Advance safety approximation of the auto-leave liveness requirement (U2). Its gate uses pendingConfIndex because the source deliberately delays conf proposals until applied >= pendingConfIndex (raft.go:747-752), so the property must not ask for earlier action than that.

entries.name: PendingConfCoversUnapplied
entries.proposed_expression:
PendingConfCoversUnapplied == \A n \in Server:
  (raft[n].alive /\ raft[n].fatal="" /\ raft[n].role="Leader") =>
    \A k \in (raft[n].applied+1)..Last(raft[n]):
       Hist(raft[n])[k].kind \in ConfKinds => k <= raft[n].pendingConf
disagreement_witness: Old model just after the first auto-leave: s1 leader, Hist[i+2]=leave, applied=i, pendingConf=i, so the property is violated. The new model has pendingConf=i+2.

entries.name: AppliedConfJointDiscipline
entries.change_kind: repair + semantic (purpose of the new admission filter and the duplicate-leave fix)
evidence: confchange.go:130-147 Simple refuses joint; EnterJoint refuses joint; LeaveJoint refuses non-joint
entries.old_expression: none (only NoUnexpectedFatal, disabled in most cfgs; EffectContract passes because Fatal keeps the config and ConfigAfter returns it unchanged)
entries.proposed_expression:
AppliedConfJointDiscipline == \A h \in history.applied: \A k \in DOMAIN h:
   h[k].kind \in ConfKinds => (IsLeave(h[k]) <=> ConfigOf(Prefix(h,k-1)).outgoing # {})
disagreement_witness: Old model W-AL1: L2 is applied after L1 left the joint config, so the property is violated.
Old model: a joint leader admits V2 Auto <<AddVoter s2>>, which is applied while joint: violated (the new source refuses it).
New model D3: joint (JointExplicit), then V2 JointExplicit <<>> is admitted (len(Changes)=0) and applied as EnterJoint while joint: violated.

entries.name: LeaderTransferTargetVoter
evidence: new raft.go:1568-1571 (Voters.IDs()) vs old raft.go:1527 (Progress membership)
entries.old_expression: none (TransferContract checks only MsgTransferLeader decisions; model base.tla:582 uses members incl. learners)
entries.proposed_expression:
LeaderTransferTargetVoter == \A n \in Server:
  (raft[n].alive /\ raft[n].fatal="" /\ raft[n].role="Leader" /\ Promotable(raft[n]) /\ raft[n].transfer#0)
     => raft[n].transfer \in VoterIDs(raft[n].config)
disagreement_witness: s1 leader admits V2 Auto <<AddLearner s3>> (Simple demotion), then TransferLeader(s1->s3) with s3 lagging, so transfer=s3 and no TimeoutNow. ApplyEntry of the demotion: the old model keeps transfer=s3 with s3 in learners (violated); the new model aborts (transfer=0). Joint variant per TestLeaderTransferDemoteNode: Remove s3 + AddLearner s3, then leave: the abort happens at the leave.
entries.notes: Scoped to promotable leaders. A leader that removed or demoted itself returns early in switchToConfig (raft.go:1537-1548) and may keep a stale transferee until the election-timeout abort.

entries.name: NewReplicaProbedOnConfApply
evidence: new raft.go:1556-1567 + confchange.go:265 (Next=LastIndex makes the sendIfEmpty=false probe non-empty)
entries.proposed_expression:
NewReplicaProbedOnConfApply == \A o \in quality.effects:
  (o.leaderBefore /\ o.leaderAfter /\ o.promotableAfter /\ o.fatal="") => o.newPeers \subseteq o.probed
with EffectObservation(r,e,a,qs) extended by: leaderBefore |-> r.role="Leader", leaderAfter |-> a.role="Leader", promotableAfter |-> Promotable(a), fatal |-> a.fatal, newPeers |-> (DOMAIN a.prs \ DOMAIN r.prs) \ {r.id}, probed |-> {m.to : m \in {x \in DOMAIN a.out: x.type \in {"MsgApp","MsgSnap"} /\ a.out[x] > (IF x \in DOMAIN r.out THEN r.out[x] ELSE 0)}}, transferBefore |-> r.transfer, transferAfter |-> a.transfer
disagreement_witness: MC.cfg (Joining {s4}): s1 leader of {s1,s2,s3} applies legacy AddVoter s4 while commit cannot advance (quorum grows). The old model sends nothing to s4 (violated). The new model sends MsgApp(index=Last-1, logTerm=Term(Last-1), entries=<<Hist[Last]>>) to s4.
entries.notes: Next=Last >= First holds at apply time because a snapshot cannot cover the conf entry being applied, so the probe takes the MsgApp path. Classed as a progress contract; see U5.

entries.name: V03 reachability canaries (negated invariants, hunt cfgs only)
entries.proposed_expression:
V03AutoLeavePendingBumpNotReached == ~\E a \in history.autoLeaveChecks: Len(a.afterHist)=a.beforeLast+1 /\ a.pending=Len(a.afterHist)
V03FullyAppliedJointLeaderNotReached == ~\E a \in history.autoLeaveChecks: a.leader /\ a.autoLeave /\ a.oldApplied=a.pendingBefore /\ a.cursor>a.pendingBefore /\ a.unappliedConf={}
V03JointRefusalNotReached == ~\E o \in quality.proposals: o.decision="Accepted" /\ o.joint /\ o.pending<=o.applied /\ \E k \in DOMAIN o.entries: o.entries[k].kind \in ConfKinds /\ o.entries[k].changes#<<>>
V03LeaveRefusalNotReached == ~\E o \in quality.proposals: o.decision="Accepted" /\ ~o.joint /\ o.pending<=o.applied /\ \E k \in DOMAIN o.entries: o.entries[k].kind="V2" /\ o.entries[k].changes=<<>>
V03ZeroWeightOverQuotaNotReached == ~\E o \in history.outcomes: o.role="Leader" /\ o.member /\ o.transfer=0 /\ o.weight=0 /\ o.quota>MaxUncommitted
V03TransferDemotionAbortNotReached == ~\E o \in quality.effects: o.leaderAfter /\ o.transferBefore#0 /\ o.transferBefore \in o.after.learners
V03NewReplicaProbeNotReached == ~\E o \in quality.effects: o.newPeers#{} /\ o.newPeers \subseteq o.probed
disagreement_witness: Each canary should be violated (reached) on the new model by the matching witness W-AL*, W-P*, transfer or probe scenario above. If a canary is not reached, that witness gives no evidence.

suspected_defects.description: Strict guard oldApplied < pendingConfIndex. A leader elected after it has already applied its whole log (applied == lastIndex == pendingConfIndex) never starts the auto-leave, and the cluster stays in the joint config. Because of the new admission rule, all non-leave conf changes are then refused until an operator proposes an explicit leave. The old source did auto-leave here.
suspected_defects.do_not_hide: Do not relax eligibility to the source's crossing predicate.

suspected_defects.severity: high if early Advance is legal (U1)
suspected_defects.description: README.md:122 allows Advance any time after persistence, so before ApplyConfChange. (a) An Advance that crosses pendingConf while the joint entry is not yet applied skips the auto-leave forever. (b) An Advance that covers the leave index before the leave is applied appends a second leave, which panics at apply ('can't leave a non-joint config'). (c) The admission joint check reads a config that lags raft.applied, so it can admit a leave that becomes invalid.

wantsLeaveJoint uses len(Changes)==0 instead of LeaveJoint(). While joint, ConfChangeV2{Transition: JointExplicit|JointImplicit, Changes: []} is admitted and then panics at apply ('config is already joint'). While not joint, the same valid enter-joint change is refused.
suspected_defects.witness: Joint via V2 JointExplicit <<Update s1>>, then propose V2 JointExplicit <<>>

suspected_defects.description: The new probe loop does not skip r.id, unlike bcastAppend. If the leader's own Progress was recreated (Next=lastIndex, Match=0), for example by applying its own removal and then a re-add, it sends MsgApp to itself. The leader ignores that message.

The auto-leave path dereferences Progress[r.id]. A leader that applied its own removal and then an inherited joint-autoLeave entry would hit a nil pointer. The model's AppendEntry has the same gap and would be a TLC evaluation error.

The comment 'Configuration changes are never refused' is too broad. Only payloads of size zero, such as the nil-Data auto-leave, are exempt; a user's explicit leave (2-byte payload) can still be refused for quota.
suspected_defects.witness: quota>0 at the limit, then propose V2 <<>> while joint: DropQuota

suspected_defects.description: The old model faithfully reproduces the old source's duplicate auto-leave, missing joint admission checks, quota rule, Next+1 and transfer check. The new model must be migrated (see required_model_and_observer_migrations). The new properties must not be weakened to match an unmigrated model.

unresolved_obligations.question: Is Advance before ApplyConfChange (EarlyAdvance=TRUE) legal for batches that contain conf entries? README.md:122 suggests it is.
unresolved_obligations.recommendation: Treat EarlyAdvance=FALSE results as the primary verdict and EarlyAdvance=TRUE as a defect hunt for D2. If the contract forbids it, constrain ProtocolAdvance rather than the properties.

unresolved_obligations.question: Auto-leave liveness (AutoLeaveProgress) needs an unbounded fairness harness.
unresolved_obligations.recommendation: Keep the per-Advance approximation in AutoLeaveAdvance until it exists.

unresolved_obligations.question: Must the leader refuse {JointExplicit|JointImplicit, Changes=[]} while joint (D3)?
unresolved_obligations.recommendation: Yes. If confirmed, change JointOK in ProposalContract to use IsLeave(e) instead of e.changes=<<>>.

unresolved_obligations.question: Concrete trace sizes: payload size and encoded size of the nil-Data V2 entry (expected 0 and the same as EmptyEncoded).
Should NewReplicaProbedOnConfApply be in the required suite or only in hunt cfgs?
unresolved_obligations.recommendation: Enable it in Update cfgs; report violations as progress regressions, not safety.

unresolved_obligations.question: V03 Update.tla lens and cfgs.
unresolved_obligations.recommendation: AffectedActions = Advance, Propose, Receive(MsgProp|MsgAppResp), ApplyEntry, TransferLeader. Hunt cfgs need V2 workload with EarlyAdvance FALSE and TRUE, PayloadWeights containing 0 and a weight > MaxUncommitted, and Joining {s4} for the probe witness.

M2 base.tla:184 AppendQuotaExceeded(r,es) == r.quota>0 /\ Weight(es)>0 /\ r.quota+Weight(es)>MaxUncommitted.

M3 base.tla:1101-1115 AdvanceCore: reduce quota first; auto == ... /\ r.applied < a.pendingConf /\ b.cursor >= a.pendingConf; on append pendingConf := Last; on refusal Fatal("refused un-refusable auto-leaving ConfChangeV2") (no retry).
M4 base.tla:336-341 RewriteConf: also rewrite when (r.config.outgoing#{} /\ es[k].changes#<<>>) \/ (r.config.outgoing={} /\ es[k].changes=<<>>).
M6 base.tla:328-329 Restore: others Progress(0,s.index,TRUE); self match s.index-1, next s.index.
M7 base.tla:579-582 ApplyConfCore: if commit did not advance, MaybeSendAppend(·,p,FALSE) for every p in Members (self included); abort transfer when c.transfer \notin VoterIDs(cfg).

M8 Observers: ProposalObservation (+joint,+cfgIndex); outcome weight from the joint-aware rewrite; autoLeaveChecks record; EffectObservation (+leaderBefore/After, promotableAfter, fatal, newPeers, probed, transferBefore/After).
